Sleep, Memory and Examination Performance

Adolescents in India sleep less than their peers elsewhere (Gupta & Iyer, 2019), and the shortfall is largest in the exam years (Kapoor et al., 2021). Joshi (2018) linked late-night study to poorer recall, although Mehta and Rao (2020) found the opposite in a boarding-school sample. A meta-analysis of 31 studies (Agarwal, 2022a) and a follow-up (Agarwal, 2022b) agree that the effect is modest. Other work is more cautious (Nair, 2017; Verma, 2023, p. 14), and one report simply describes attendance (Pratham, 2023).
